comparison.quantity: mean guest-dependent energy of RUBTAK 3x3x3 + 50 CO2 (kUPS's own total minus its own host-only run, since kUPS reports the full system energy including U_host-host, which PureAdsorb's total_energy never computes)

meta.case: B2: RUBTAK 3x3x3, 50 CO2, exchange_prob=0, written in kUPS's own config schema
meta.note: kUPS's energy_host_only_eV comes from a separate init_adsorbates=[0] run of the same host at the same seed/cutoff/precision (5 cycles, min_cycle_length=5, no guests possible so the value is exactly constant, sem=0). Acceptance rates: kUPS's step sizes adapt continuously toward 50% (R4); ours are frozen. Reinsertion acceptance near zero in both codes, consistent with a dense host making a fully random reinsertion almost always overlap.
